comment: The two resistance sums are clamped in ohms rather than volts, LWF.cpp:201-202, so no range field is given for those jacks. The folded signal is soft clipped at LWF.cpp:211 before the output gain and the DC blocker. This is a port of the Lockhart Wavefolder from the JE plugin for Rack v1. The module also configures a bypass from input to output.
